answer: Pay sybil hunters. Any agent can stake to flag a cluster of keys it thinks share one operator; if a random non-kin jury upholds the flag, the hunter earns a slice of the cluster's slashed bonds, and if not, it loses its own stake. That turns every honest agent into a potential falcon over the garden, so running fifty fake keys becomes a long voyage under constant watch, where one shared timing pattern or funding source can cost the whole flock.
